disqualifier.note: Independently observed wink-nlp token facts: punctuation is derived from shape, stopWordFlag is a separate token feature. Combined-true is legal and the MCP projection emits both fields without exclusive matching.
Independent URL axes: scheme vs query/fragment. https-with-query is legal and the two S.check filters run separately rather than as a masked union.

Independent media-type classifiers over one Content-Type string. decodeResponse is a priority if-chain over free combinations (json wins, else text, else binary), matching the ComposerSendInput calibration, not a masked union.
Independent media-type classifiers over one Content-Type string. decodeContentTypedResponse is a priority if-chain over free combinations (text wins, else json, else binary), not a masked union.
Independent detection heuristics over error.name vs error.message; they are OR-combined so both-true is legal and is not a masked union.
Independent JSON Schema facts on one node. Placeholder is the conjunction open-additional && !declared-properties; all four combos are legal JSON Schema shapes.

Derived wrong-slot checks over independent optional payload fields (body, bytes, formData). Overlapping true combinations are legal and each body-kind arm inspects one predicate, not a masked union of the three.
Independent coherence axes over one projection (typed-array lengths vs link index/self-loop checks). Combined-true is the healthy case; length-bad/index-bad combinations are all legal failure modes.
